known_limitations.reason: QueryEngine does not expose total_pushed today. CursorDto fields are encoded but cannot be cross-checked. Caller-supplied cursors are accepted as-is.

known_limitations.reason: QueryEngine has no AST-aware function index; substring is the cheapest useful heuristic. False positives possible (e.g. 'foo' matches 'foobar').
known_limitations.future: m7+ may add regex or glob support if user demand emerges

notes: events_read dispatcher reuses the existing chronos_domain::bus::EventCursor + CursorStatus infrastructure that was already used by probe_drain — no new cursor types were introduced

CursorDto encodes only the fields the dispatcher can honour (total_pushed + snapshot_len) — distinct from a hypothetical base64-encoded opaque cursor string. This was an intentional departure from the spec hypothesised encoding because the domain already exposes the equivalent values
The v1 query_events shim translates offset/limit to a CursorDto at the MCP boundary (offset→total_pushed, limit→snapshot_len). Cursor wins if both supplied
Two new ServiceError variants (CursorStale, InvalidCursorPayload) required exhaustive match arm updates in chronos-mcp — matches the 'add new variant arm to each call site' pattern from AGENTS.md
No clippy drift introduced; no module-level #[allow] needed
Honest disclosure policy applied: every commit message lists known limitations in a dedicated section
